conventions.contract: CONTRACT_GEUMBANG §AQ (plan docs/geumbang_plan.md §6, §7, §10). Paths relative to frost-village/assets/. Fragment name: ui6 (late fragment, plan §12 G-P6).
conventions.mark: 금방이: gold disc, goldDark rim, cream sticker border, a face-on cream parcel with navy dot eyes, pink cheeks and an "o" mouth, a cream 4-point sparkle above. Same design as assets/geumbang (gb_lib.mark, variant A).
conventions.text: Text is baked ONLY into ui_gb_logo_ko ("금방") and ui_gb_logo_en ("Geumbang"); the game writes every other label (Pretendard). Body text >= 15 CSS px (28 logical), tap targets >= 44 CSS px, statuses always icon + word.
conventions.style: House soft-toy style (fxlib.toy): dark tinted outline, bevel lit from the upper left, gloss, one navy drop shadow; the mark is lit from straight above so it stays its own mirror image.
conventions.nineSlice: Panel frames live in the atlas UNTRIMMED: this.add.nineslice(x, y, 'ui6_gb', key, w, h, left, right, top, bottom) with nineSlice[key]. contentInset = [left, top, right, bottom] px from the stretched edges where content goes. Chip and ribbon: build them at their source height and scale uniformly (minHeight).

pagePlan.why: plan §10.4: the build packs the resident part with gb_bld_0 into gb_core; the app frames, tracker, logos and mascot ship as a transient page acquired only while the app is open.

hud.edgeBadge: UIv42.updateEdge clamps the left-side nav edge badge to y >= 480; while the 금방 chip shows, the left column ends at y 528 (its hit rect), so that clamp should become 540

conventions.appLayoutNotes: Suggested layout of the 720 x 1100 logical app panel (plan §6): the phone 9-slice fills the panel; header / tabs / content rects are in panel px; tracker y and x0..x1 are card px. The panel fills the viewport width, so every tap target is >= 88 logical (44 CSS on a 360 CSS phone, 47.7 on 390), body text 30 (15 / 16.3 CSS) and no text under 24 (12 / 13 CSS). Tabs / the follow button are the 64-tall 9-slices scaled uniformly by tabs.scale / button.scale; the catalog sell toggle is drawn 44 tall but its hit area is the 88-tall right half of the row (toggle.hitH). English tab words are the short set Today / Order / Shop / Crew / Stars. docs/previews/ui6_app.png and ui6_phaser_*.png show it.

ui_gb_mascot.notes: 금방이 the mascot: the mark's parcel on stubby legs with a navy scarf under its "o" mouth (UI only). idle = stands, waves and calls (3 fps loop); run = runs to the LEFT (8 fps loop) - when the app opens it enters from behind the right edge of the phone screen: start at appLayout.header.mascotRunIn.from (masked to appLayout.screen, depth under the close button), tween x to appLayout.header.mascot in 600 ms with LINEAR easing (a braking ease makes the feet slide while the legs still cycle), then play idle at once (bow on the first open of the day). To run right, setFlipX(true) (mirror-safe: no letters, a symmetric face; the light then comes from the upper right, which is fine for a moment of motion). bow = a polite bow (3 fps once; the first delivery / a new review). Feet at the anchor in every frame.

ui_gb_phone.notes: the 금방 앱 panel (720 x 1100 logical, non-pausing) drawn as the chief's phone: charcoal bezel, cream screen. screenRect [21, 30, 318, 580] at the source size; the screen corners are r 30, so the header (r 30) sits flush in it. Build it at any size (the edge strips are plain: polish L1), then draw ui_gb_phone_notch (speaker slot + camera) centred at appLayout.notch.

ui_gb_header.notes: the app header (gold): rounded top corners r 30 = the phone screen's, a goldDark lip, a soft shadow onto the screen below (the last 12 px). Logo left, tagline under it (navy, 26 px), close button right, the mascot runs in between (appLayout.header).

ui_gb_tab.notes: app tab (not selected): pale cream; write the word in warm grey #6B5D48 (>= 4.5:1) next to the tab icon.

ui_gb_tab_on.notes: app tab (selected): gold with gloss and a small shadow; word in navy. Same size and margins as ui_gb_tab so they swap in place. A new-content dot is code (a 14 px gold circle, white rim).

ui_gb_card.notes: order / product / stat card: warm white, hairline border, soft shadow, a gold strip down the left edge (inside the left margin). Done cards may setTint(0xF4F1EA).

ui_gb_chip.notes: HUD 금방 chip and in-app buttons (따라가기): cream pill with a gold rim; ui_chip rules - build at 64 tall, setScale(h / 64) for smaller chips (minHeight 64). In the HUD it matches the v4.2 업무 chip (polish M2): 172 x 50 logical right under it, 20 px text, 36 px icon, with an invisible 88-tall hit rect (appLayout.hud.chip).

ui_gb_toast.notes: toast (<= 300 x 48 CSS): cream with a gold left edge; icon at contentInset left, one line of text. Built 64 tall at the v4.2 hint pill's centre (361, 148), hiding the hint pill while it shows (polish M2: appLayout.hud.toast) - never over the coin bar or the left chips.

ui_gb_ribbon.notes: blank gold ribbon with swallowtail ends for 특가 / 배달 중 / NEW labels (navy text, centred). Build it 48 tall and stretch only the width (minHeight 48).

ui_gb_photo.notes: doorstep photo print (fixed size, not a 9-slice): draw the 128 x 80 render texture at photoRect (x 24, y 16 from the frame's top-left) UNDER the frame - the window is transparent and its edge carries a soft inner shade; the gold tape and the mark sticker sit on top. Scale the whole thing for thumbnails.

ui_gb_phone_notch.notes: the phone's speaker slot (centred) + front camera (polish L1: no longer in the stretched 9-slice). Fixed size, never scaled with the panel: draw it centred at appLayout.notch (panel x 360, y 15.5) over the built ui_gb_phone.

fx_gb_bell.notes: 띵동 at the door (world space, with sfx_gb_doorbell on ring_doorbell's impact frame 2): the bell pops in, swings with ringing arcs and sparkles, settles. SIZE (polish H2): S = min(24 CSS px, 0.7 x the courier on screen) = min(24 / cssPerWorld, 56) world px, cssPerWorld = camera zoom x viewport CSS width / 720; setScale(S / 64). PLACE: above the courier's head, a little toward the door - centre x = feet.x + bellPoint.x + 10 x sign(bellPoint.x), its bottom edge 4 world px above the head top (feet.y + placement.headTopY - 4; centre y = bottom - 0.4 S, the bell + arcs are 0.8 S tall) - never over a face; depth over the courier. The resident steps out after the bell has gone (plan 8.1: ring 4.5 s, door 5.5 s). DONG (L6): on sfx_gb_doorbell's dong cue (0.33 s) play frames 1-3 again, then hold frame 3 and fade it out over 0.32 s, so the bell lasts the whole 0.9 s chime; destroy after.
